subject: Payment failed for invoice #ZH-1147 — VAT info needed
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zephyrhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice failed to process (Invoice ZH-1147)

Hi Karthik / Monica,

Our finance team received a notice from Stripe that the charge for invoice ZH-1147 (period ending 2026-04-01) failed with decline code: card_declined. The charge is for €24,500 EUR. Can you confirm whether you can retry the card on file, or provide an alternative billing method?

A couple of important notes from our side: our billing entity is Zephyr Health EU (Ireland) — we need the invoice to include your VAT number and the correct reverse-charge VAT notation before accounting can accept it. If you can send a pro-forma VAT invoice we can expedite the payment.

I’ve attached the Stripe decline email we received (screenshot). Please advise the next steps — we’re trying to avoid a chargeback.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Corporate Finance
Zephyr Health

Subject: Re: Invoice failed to process (Invoice ZH-1147)

Hi Laura — thanks for flagging this. Sorry for the hiccup. I’ll coordinate with finance to get a VAT-compliant pro-forma over and confirm whether we can retry the card on file.

Quick Qs: can you confirm the last 4 digits of the card on file (for our records) and whether your team prefers we attempt one retry or wait for a new card? We can also send a secure payment update link if your billing admin prefers to enter a new method.

I’m looping in Monica from Billing — Monica, can you take point on the pro-forma and retry policy?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-04-16T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Invoice failed to process (Invoice ZH-1147)

Thanks Karthik — I’ll prepare the pro-forma with our VAT registration and the reverse-charge wording. Draft plan:

- Issue pro-forma invoice (proforma_ZH-1147.pdf) with VAT details today.
- Authorize a single retry attempt on the existing Stripe payment method if Laura confirms the last 4 digits. If retry fails, we’ll send a secure payment update link and put the account on a 7-day courtesy hold.
- If Zephyr indicates a potential chargeback, we’ll escalate to Risk & Collections and hold new provisioning until cleared.

Michael — FYI, this is a €24,500 EU invoice; please confirm we’re good to perform a single automated retry (retry window open until 2026-04-20).

Monica Patel
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
Attachment: proforma_ZH-1147.pdf
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zephyrhealth.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Eoin O'Neill <eoin.oneill@zephyrhealth.eu>
Date: 2026-04-18T14:05:00+01:00
Subject: RE: Invoice failed to process (Invoice ZH-1147)

Hi Monica / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick response — attaching the Stripe notice you sent earlier for reference. The last 4 digits on the card on file are 4242, which matches our internal note.

We are the EU entity; VAT number is IE3456789A. Please include this on the invoice and add the following wording: "Reverse charge — VAT due by the recipient under Article 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC."

If you prefer to retry, please go ahead with one attempt. If the retry is unsuccessful, we will update the card through the secure link. There is no active chargeback yet but our internal team flagged a dispute warning — we want to avoid that.

Could you also confirm whether the retry counts as a new authorization (i.e., will it reattempt the same authorization, or create a separate authorization that could impact our daily limits)?

Regards,
Laura Chen
Head of Corporate Finance
Zephyr Health
Attachment: stripe-decline-snip.png
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@zephyrhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-20T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice failed to process (Invoice ZH-1147)

Hi Laura — thanks for confirming the last 4 digits and VAT number.

Monica confirmed we can do a single retry. A few operational notes:
- Retry behavior: Stripe will attempt to re-authorize the same card. If the authorization fails at bank level, there will be no additional capture attempts. It should not create a duplicate final charge if unsuccessful; it’s a single new authorization attempt.
- We will attempt the retry today at 16:00 UTC. If you prefer to update the card first, you can use this secure link to add a new payment method: https://pay.redwood.ai/update-method?token=zh-1147-abc123 (expires in 72 hours).

As a one-time courtesy we can extend access through 2026-04-27 while collections completes, provided we receive confirmation of payment or a new card by then. If retry fails we’ll follow up with a short collections workflow (no immediate service interruption until 04/27).

Please reply with confirmation to proceed with the retry at 16:00 UTC or with intent to update the card.

Best,
Karthik
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-21T16:35:00-07:00
Subject: Payment update: ZH-1147 — successful capture and reconciliation

Team — quick update for the ledger and close out:

- Stripe capture succeeded at 2026-04-21T15:48:13Z after the retry (card ending 4242). Receipt attached.
- We recorded VAT note and saved Zephyr’s VAT number on the invoice. Final settled amount: €24,500 EUR (no VAT charged; reverse-charge applied).
- No chargeback filed. Zephyr confirmed successful payment to their bank.

Actions taken: proforma_ZH-1147.pdf -> finalized, stripe-receipt-ZH-1147.pdf attached, accounting ticket #ACCT-2026-459 closed. Please update revenue recognition for April.

Thanks everyone — I’ll mark the HubSpot opportunity as paid.

Monica Patel
